comments.author: gadimus
comments.body:
Your standard central features are OK but are characters and compendium necessary to have in there? Could those two be joined together?

Dashboard and Show Profile and the Player high score block seem really out of place

I would probably push Compendium, Dashboard, Profile to be three buttons below the toilet paper dude 

..or...

you could make these features that appear in later play sessions. When someone first opens the game they don't need most of that extra stuff - even story items is just noise until they have a run or two.

comments.author: witmann_pl
comments.body:
I'd try adding a semi-transparent overlay between the background and the UI elements and experiment with 2 variants to see which one looks better - either a bright overlay to make the background brighter which should make the dark UI elements stand out more, or a dark overlay with bright UI elements.

comments.author: Cool-Chemical-5629
comments.body:
Anything anyone could say here would be highly subjective, so if that's okay with you, here's my humble take:

Some of the effects in the background animations are distracting me and I'd change the colors of the UI elements. While the black background for buttons and info panel improve readability of the text, it feels like it's too dark when there are many such elements shown at the same time. Maybe a subtle transparency for those backgrounds would make it better.

replies.author: JuyuLabs
replies.body: I disagree with most of this. The animations are intentional, and adding transparency would likely make readability worse, not better. The only fair point is that too many dark elements can make the UI feel heavy.
